name: MyLINK Connect Web Chat
author: MyLINK Connect

sections.description:
This plugin allows quick configuration of the MyLINK Connect Web Chat Widget by using the simple parameters you can obtain from your account publish dialog.
Copy and paste the required MyLINK Connect parameters and the Chatbot snippet will be automatically generated in your pages.

This plugin relies on the MyLINK Connect chatbot platform for every chatbot functionality. Please make sure to check MyLINK Connect main website at https://www.xenioo.com.

MyLINK Connect Terms Of Service:https://www.xenioo.com/terms-of-service/
MyLINK Connect Privacy Policy:https://www.xenioo.com/privacy-policy/
